notes.title: A little about the Cartoon Team.
notes.notes:
Welcome fighter, here we will talk about the game and we will also publish the progress of the game development. Subscribe to updates so you don't miss anything!

[h1] And so. What is the game about?[/h1]

Toon Team is a shooter with RPG elements, choose your fighter and team, fight in one of the many game modes. And also build and create your own content.

[h1]Teams and Fighters[/h1]

The choice of the player is presented * 4 combat classes and two sides of the conflict. Reds and Blues who decide who is the coolest. Each fighter has their own set of weapons. The fighter's weapons can be combined as you like and create your perfect set for yourself.

List of combat classes.
[olist]
[*] Soldier
[*] Sniper
[*] Demoman
[*] Heavy
[/olist]
[h1]Weapon[/h1]

The player can choose from a wide arsenal of firearms and throwing weapons of 20 types of weapons. Firearms, cold, throwing, explosives and so on.

[h1]Abilities[/h1]

Also, during the game on the map, special zones are provided for the player where you can pick up unique abilities for a while. For example: super jump, acceleration or damage increase and so on.

[h1]Game Modes[/h1]

Classic game modes are available to the player. Such as: DeathMatch , Team DeathMatch , Capture The Flag , Co-op Base Defense vs. Bots. Also, the player will be able to create their own Creative mode and fully program it and play with friends.

[h1]Map Editor[/h1]

An in-game map editor is available for creators to create their own combat arena. On the created maps, you can play with friends and distribute them.

* We will provide more detailed information on combat classes, weapons, characteristics and abilities in the next updates. Subscribe to our updates so you don't miss out!
